sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ?=? THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adj_knows k1 WHERE k1.src=? AND k1.dst=?) THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adj_knows k1 JOIN adj_knows k2 ON k2.src=k1.dst WHERE k1.src=? AND k2.dst=?) THEN 2 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adj_knows k1 JOIN adj_knows k2 ON k2.src=k1.dst JOIN adj_knows k3 ON k3.src=k2.dst WHERE k1.src=? AND k3.dst=?) THEN 3 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adj_knows k1 JOIN adj_knows k2 ON k2.src=k1.dst JOIN adj_knows k3 ON k3.src=k2.dst JOIN adj_knows k4 ON k4.src=k3.dst WHERE k1.src=? AND k4.dst=?) THEN 4 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adj_knows k1 JOIN adj_knows k2 ON k2.src=k1.dst JOIN adj_knows k3 ON k3.src=k2.dst JOIN adj_knows k4 ON k4.src=k3.dst JOIN adj_knows k5 ON k5.src=k4.dst WHERE k1.src=? AND k5.dst=?) THEN 5 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM adj_knows k1 JOIN adj_knows k2 ON k2.src=k1.dst JOIN adj_knows k3 ON k3.src=k2.dst JOIN adj_knows k4 ON k4.src=k3.dst JOIN adj_knows k5 ON k5.src=k4.dst JOIN adj_knows k6 ON k6.src=k5.dst WHERE k1.src=? AND k6.dst=?) THEN 6 ELSE -1 END AS length
